I couldn't set up the weekly digest. The scheduler refused the request with a Gateway credentials error, so nothing is scheduled and nothing will post on Monday 19 Oct. I've told you that in #coastal-team.

The digest is still a go once scheduling works. Here is what it would do:

- **When:** Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 Oct.
- **Where:** posted to #coastal-team.
- **Content:** last week's items from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus open customer items, with each item labelled by channel.
- **Left out:** finance figures (rates, prices, contract values, payment terms) and anything from DMs. A customer item that depends on a money term would only be flagged as needing a finance check.

Your channels have the same members (you, Kwame and Sofia), so the digest won't expose anything to people who couldn't already see it.

Someone with Gateway admin access will need to fix the scheduler's credentials. Once that's done, I can create the job and confirm it here.
